args.goal: Check for equivalent work first. Use the Wikimedia Foundation RFP index capture if committed and relevant. Verify the deadline, deliverable, acceptance criterion, intended supplier eligibility, response route and stated payment terms from the original notice. Record absent terms as unknown. Read back committed evidence and close under a valid lease with a lesson. No external submissions, spending or deployment.
